details: The Federal Reserve is widely expected to maintain its current interest rates at the upcoming June 2026 meeting due to persistent inflation, with markets pricing in a high probability of a pause. This "higher for longer" interest rate environment is tightening global liquidity, strengthening the U.S. dollar, and encouraging investors to rotate out of speculative assets like cryptocurrencies and into traditional safe havens or growth-oriented tech stocks. Upcoming U.S. employment and inflation data, particularly the May Non-Farm Payrolls and CPI reports, are closely watched for any potential shifts in monetary policy outlook.
title: Fed Poised to Hold Rates Amid Persistent Inflation, Weighing on Crypto

details: Bitcoin has fallen below the critical $63,000 support level, reaching a multi-month low, driven by a wave of deleveraging, significant institutional outflows from spot Bitcoin ETFs, and broader macroeconomic pressures including persistent inflation and delayed Fed rate cuts. Over $3 billion has been wiped out in crypto derivatives liquidations recently, and a rotation of capital towards AI-related stocks has accelerated the decline. The market sentiment is currently flagged as "extreme fear."
title: Bitcoin Dips Below $63K Amid Heavy ETF Outflows and Macro Pressures

details: Kazakhstan's central bank is preparing significant changes to its cryptocurrency market, including exploring a crypto amnesty and allowing digital assets to be used as collateral for loans. The National Bank plans to establish a specialized committee for crypto industry oversight, aiming to integrate digital assets with traditional financial infrastructure. This move is part of an effort to bring unregulated market activity into a transparent framework and position Kazakhstan as a leader in digital asset innovation.

details: U.S. lawmakers are advancing comprehensive cryptocurrency tax and regulatory bills, including provisions to clarify rules for stablecoins and digital assets. Efforts like the "Clarity Act" entering the Senate legislative calendar and the GENIUS Act aim to establish clearer frameworks for the crypto industry. While regulatory uncertainty can weigh on market sentiment in the short term, the establishment of clear, enforceable rules is generally seen as a positive development for long-term institutional participation and market stability.
title: US Lawmakers Advance Bills to Clarify Crypto Tax & Stablecoin Rules
